name: Daily Quests
description: The online game's 808 one-off event quests come back as daily quests: {{count}} random ones each game day, different for every player. {{decals}} of them pay a decal that cannot be had any other way offline on the first clear; the rest pay Death Metals (Kill Coins without the Death Metals mod).
author: KSFA

settings.label: Quests a day
settings.help: How many of the pool's quests are open each game day (from 10:00 UTC, or when the manager's Start a new game day is used). They are picked at random for you, and stay the same all day, restarts included.

settings.label: Decal quests a day
settings.help: How many of the day's quests pay a decal on their first clear: one of the 80 that cannot be had any other way offline, each on a quest of its own. The rest pay Death Metals. 0 for none. Collab decals need the LET IT DIE Crossover Content pack; without it their quests do not come up. If there are fewer to pick from than asked, Death Metal quests make up the day.

settings.label: Death Metal quests pay

options.label: The quest's own reward from the online game

settings.help: What the quests without a decal pay for every clear, and what a decal quest pays after its first. Death Metals need the Death Metals mod; without it, each Death Metal is paid as 5,000 Kill Coins, as the offline game does. The online rewards are mostly items, Kill Coins and Lost Bags.

patches.description: 808 quests, their goals and their decal rewards

patches.sql:
DELETE FROM master_const_int WHERE id = 'LID_DAILY_QUEST_COUNT';
INSERT INTO master_const_int (id, value) VALUES ('LID_DAILY_QUEST_COUNT', {{count}});

DELETE FROM master_const_int WHERE id = 'LID_DAILY_DECAL_COUNT';
INSERT INTO master_const_int (id, value) VALUES ('LID_DAILY_DECAL_COUNT', {{decals}});

UPDATE master_quest SET rwd = 'RWD_MEDAL_' || MIN(20, MAX(1, (lvl / 2) * CAST(substr('{{repeat_reward}}', 3) AS INTEGER))) WHERE start_date = 1 AND end_date = 2 AND event_type = 'QUESTEVENT_NORMAL';
UPDATE master_quest SET first_rwd = rwd WHERE start_date = 1 AND end_date = 2 AND event_type = 'QUESTEVENT_NORMAL' AND first_rwd NOT LIKE 'RWD_LID_DQ_%';

patches.description: The quests pay the online rewards
patches.sql:
UPDATE master_quest SET rwd = (SELECT o.rwd FROM master_quest_online o WHERE o.qid = master_quest.qid) WHERE start_date = 1 AND end_date = 2 AND event_type = 'QUESTEVENT_NORMAL' AND qid IN (SELECT qid FROM master_quest_online);
UPDATE master_quest SET first_rwd = (SELECT o.first_rwd FROM master_quest_online o WHERE o.qid = master_quest.qid) WHERE start_date = 1 AND end_date = 2 AND event_type = 'QUESTEVENT_NORMAL' AND first_rwd NOT LIKE 'RWD_LID_DQ_%' AND qid IN (SELECT qid FROM master_quest_online);
